proposition.object:
## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 6 outcomes and 5 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **82° to 83°**: 32% (bid 31 cents, ask 32 cents; 834 contracts in 24 hours)
- **79° or below**: 24% (bid 23 cents, ask 24 cents; 1 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **80° to 81°**: 22% (bid 21 cents, ask 23 cents; 545 contracts in 24 hours)
- **84° to 85°**: 21% (bid 20 cents, ask 21 cents; 604 contracts in 24 hours)
- **86° to 87°**: 7% (bid 6 cents, ask 7 cents; 994 contracts in 24 hours)
- **88° or above**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 312 contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxhighaus/highest-temperature-in-austin/kxhighaus-26oct04) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

Our own model, built on NOAA's National Blend of Models forecast, puts 82° to 83° at 32% (the market: 32%), 79° or below at 13% (the market: 24%), and 80° to 81° at 22% (the market: 22%). The model has not beaten the market near the middle of the range in our out-of-sample test, so we treat Kalshi's price as the better estimate there and use the model chiefly to judge the extreme brackets.

What the view rests on:

- **Settlement station**: KAUS (NWS Daily Climate Report CLIAUS) ([source](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=NWS&product=CLI&issuedby=AUS))
- **National Blend of Models daytime maximum guidance**: 82 F with NBM spread 3 F, run 2026-10-03T18:00:00.000Z, 30 hours ahead ([source](https://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20261003/18/text/blend_nbstx.t18z))
- **House error model**: location 82.4 F, scale 2.32 F, Student-t with 5.97 degrees of freedom, fitted on 2026-08-05..10-02 (content/config/temperature-markets.json)
- **Measured skill**: Out of sample the model alone lost to the Kalshi mid near the money (Brier 0.138-0.164 vs 0.119-0.130); it is used to certify far tails, where brackets asked at 5c or less with model p of 1% or less settled yes on 0 of 296 high markets (data/records/2026-10-03-kalshi-temperature-tail-backtest).

## How does this market resolve?

> If the maximum temperature recorded at Austin (CLIAUS) for Oct 4, 2026, is less than 80° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 5, 2026 at 06:00 UTC. Expected settlement: October 5, 2026 at 19:00 UTC. Settlement source: [The Weather Company](https://weather.com/kalshi). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/GLOBALTEMPERATURE.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- The next NBM run (hourly; the current run is 2026-10-03T18:00:00.000Z).
- A new National Blend of Models or National Weather Service forecast run, issued hourly.
- For a same-day high, the maximum already observed at the station (the day's high cannot settle below it); for a low, the minimum so far.
- A correction or late revision to the NWS Daily Climate Report that settles the market.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 359 settled Climate and Weather markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.0879; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 1.8% of the time (109 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (5 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "Highest temperature in Austin on Oct 4, 2026"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies 82° to 83° at 32%, 79° or below at 24%, and 80° to 81° at 22%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxhighaus/highest-temperature-in-austin/kxhighaus-26oct04.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 5, 2026 at 06:00 UTC and is expected to settle October 5, 2026 at 19:00 UTC, in about 34 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names The Weather Company (https://weather.com/kalshi) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/GLOBALTEMPERATURE.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

Kalshi is a federally regulated exchange (a CFTC-designated contract market). Whether you can trade depends on your location and eligibility under Kalshi's terms. The market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxhighaus/highest-temperature-in-austin/kxhighaus-26oct04.

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.

## About these odds

Odds are a snapshot taken October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC from Kalshi's public market data and are not a prediction. This uses public information only and is not financial advice; prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price. The 561 Group, which publishes this wire and Koios.News, may trade on Kalshi, including in this market.

Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.
